pages.text: Spiders are large, greedy arthropods. By luring them with their favorite meat, you have devised a spell to summon these agile assassins to fight for you at a moment's notice.

Using a $(l:crafts/staff/wild_staff)Wild Staff$() summons Web Spider Servants, while using a $(l:crafts/staff/geo_staff)Geo Staff$() summons Cave Spider Servants instead. A $(l:crafts/staff/frost_staff)Frost Staff$() summons Ice Spider Servants, and a $(l:crafts/staff/necro_staff)Necro Staff$() can summon Bone Spider Servants, while a $(l:crafts/staff/nether_staff)Nether Staff$() summons Crimson Spider Servants.
